Package net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.engine

Class WPRestClient

java.lang.Object
net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.engine.WPRestClient
public class WPRestClient extends Object
Facade for the WordPress REST API.

Wraps RestClientService with a user-friendly, stateful client bound to a WPSiteInfo and an SSLContext. Obtain instances via of(WPSiteInfo) or of(WPSiteInfo, SSLContext).

Author:
Yoham Gabriel @ YGBStudio
